text: What should you talk about on a first date? Here is the golden rule. Keep it light. Keep it fun Keep it easy. This ain't a job interview or a therapy session So what do we actually talk about? Topic one, traveling. Places you've been to and places you want to go to. Topic two, food and drinks. What do you love to eat? What do you like to drink? Best places to eat in town, best bars and stories related to it. Topic three, your background. Where are you from? Which languages do you speak? Funny stories from your childhood. Topic four, pop culture. Your favorite movies, best TV shows you watched, what music you listen to, whatever you are into. Topic five, hobbies. What fires you up outside of work? Do you dance? Do you work out? Do you play some team sports? You can talk about that. Extra credit, you can also touch on the topic of work, books, your friends and so on. Just remember, keep it light, keep it fun and keep it easy. It's your first date. You are not trying to impress. You are trying to vibe and have a good time.
